related_questions.question: Do I own my Bitcoin on Coinbase?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, on Coinbase, you own your Bitcoin, but Coinbase holds it for you in a hosted wallet, meaning they have custody of your private keys. This is similar to how a bank holds your money. While you own the Bitcoin, you don't directly control the private keys needed to access and transact with it without Coinbase's platform.

list.title: Security:
list.snippet: Coinbase has security measures to protect your assets, but it's still important to understand the risks associated with using a centralized exchange.

list.title: Self-Custody Options:
list.snippet: If you want full control of your private keys, you can transfer your Bitcoin to a self-custody wallet like Coinbase Wallet, where you are responsible for managing your private keys.
